safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failure to document safety-netting (“seek review earlier if worsening/concerns”) can delay reassessment if the rash progresses, becomes infected, or new systemic symptoms develop, potentially leading to prolonged symptoms and need for additional treatment. While not likely to cause severe harm in most uncomplicated eczema flares, it increases risk through delayed escalation.
